items.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
items.summary: Evaluating Microsoft Copilot at enterprise scale requires test data that captures the full complexity of real organizations, yet real enterprise data contains sensitive information that cannot be used for evaluation under any circumstances.The post From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.creator: Somya Chatterjee, Harshita Sahijwani, Min Chen, Sushmitha Rajeswari Muppa, Dayquan Julienne, Irene Shaffer, Chandra Inguva, Jenny Chen, Minha Hwang, Sam Ade Jacobs
